target.trafficModel: Live TV beta cohort with normal channel zapping and catch-up attempts kept on provider media bytes.

checks.description: Provider/XUI owner confirms the QA/beta account and upstream service can support the planned 300-500 live-user beta without adding XUI-side transcode/remux.
Lumen web/proxy path capacity is sized for the beta cohort and does not perform per-user media processing.
Browser/network/process evidence shows catch-up failures are handled with provider bytes, normalized manifests, or unsupported overlays, not ffmpeg/remux/transcode/generated HLS.
Beta launch has monitored startup, playback failure, provider error, and no-media-processing signals with named owner response.
Rollback or enrollment throttle plan is approved for provider overload, playback regressions, or capacity breach.
